# 黃庭內景經

**ID:** KR5i0011
**Date (file):** 2015-08-29 17:48:32.192795
**Base edition:** CK-KZ

## Authors / Editors
- DZJY  黃庭內景經

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Scripture of the Inner Effulgence of the Yellow Court*

base scripture transmitted in the name of [魏華存](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%AD%8F%E8%8F%AF%E5%AD%98) (Lady Wèi Huácún, 4th c. CE); commentary by [蔣國祚](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%94%A3%E5%9C%8B%E7%A5%9A) (Jiǎng Guózuò, *zì* Méizhōng) of the early-Qīng era, prefaced by [許尚質](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A8%B1%E5%B0%9A%E8%B3%AA) (Xǔ Shàngzhì of Shānyīn, *zì* Yòuwén)

The Shàngqīng *Huáng tíng nèi jǐng jīng* — the more developed companion of the *Wài jǐng jīng* (cf. [KR5i0012](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0012)) — here printed in the **Dào zàng jí yào** with an early-Qīng Southern-school *nèidān* commentary by Jiǎng Guózuò. The same canonical 36-section, 7-character base scripture appears at [KR5i0010](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0010) in a different (planchette-overlay) recension; the present text is **the philological-alchemical recension**: the apparatus is more conservative, the commentary signed by a named Daoist scholar, and the framing prefaces are by named human authors (Xǔ Shàngzhì of Shānyīn) rather than planchette deities.

**Abstract**

The base scripture is the canonical *Huáng tíng nèi jǐng jīng* in 36 sections of 7-character verse — the same text whose textual history reaches back to the Shàngqīng dispensation of c. 350 CE and is canonically transmitted in Lady Wèi Huácún's name (cf. [KR5i0010](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0010) for the parallel DZJY recension, with full discussion of the underlying scripture). The present recension differs from [KR5i0010](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0010) in two important respects: (i) the absence of the planchette-frame (no Lǚ Dòngbīn / Eight-Cavern apparatus), and (ii) the substitution of a literarily-respectable Qīng scholarly commentary by Jiǎng Guózuò (the alchemist's, not the medium's, voice) supported by a parallel-prose *xù* by the local literatus Xǔ Shàngzhì.

The dating is internal: Xǔ Shàngzhì is recorded in CBDB with index year 1659 (his birth year), placing him in the late-Kāng-xī to mid-Yōng-zhèng generation; Jiǎng Guózuò's commentary is presumably contemporary, c. 1700–1750. The text was not in the Zhèngtǒng Dàozàng; its preservation is via the DZJY of 1809 → Kanripo.

The commentary is recognisably *nèidān* in orientation, building each gloss around the Southern-school doctrine of *xìngmìng* (*xìng* = nature; *mìng* = vital force) dual cultivation; chapter-headings are aligned with the standard inner-elixir cosmology (lead-mercury, kǎnlí, fire-phasing). It is a useful witness to early-Qīng *Huáng tíng* exegesis outside the planchette-circle that produced [KR5i0010](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0010) and the Liǔ Shǒuyuán materials.
